verdict.rationale: This axis fairly applies to an IP filing office. The evidence pack only lists filing-procedure page titles (trademark, patent, design, e-Soleau) and none of them describe the account, credential, or identity-proofing steps required before filing. The data.inpi.fr probe shows a token wall on the open-data portal, which was discovered at request time rather than published, and it concerns data access, not filing prerequisites.
